name: Charizard VSTAR vs Rayquaza VMAX Special Deck Set

releases.name: Charizard VSTAR vs Rayquaza VMAX Special Deck Set

description.text: Special Deck Set Charizard VSTAR vs Rayquaza VMAX, released on 4 November 2022: a Charizard VSTAR deck and a Rayquaza VMAX deck, both Pokémon in new illustrations, with two deck cases, two VSTAR markers, a playmat, coins, damage counters, a damage counter case and a card box that holds everything, ready for two players.
